past.body:
(Weekly) Doumar's cruise-in Hosted by The Mustang and Ford Association of Virginia

Wednesday, August 26th | 6-8p

Located at Doumar's Cones & Barbecue, 1919 Monticello Ave., Norfolk.

Please join us for some cars at a weekly cruise-in every Wednesday night until it gets cold, all are invited! Bring your rides out and have some fun. They are open during these hours, so enjoy all the great eats and drinks they provide, including their amazing ice cream and handmade cones!

past.title: MCT presents Summer Sizzle Car Show | Aug 8th
past.body:
MCT presents Summer Sizzle Car Show

Saturday, August 8th | 9a-2p

Located at Cavalier Ford | 4021 Portsmouth Boulevard, Chesapeake VA 23321

This show is hosted by Cavalier Ford Chesapeake Square, a sponsor of the Mustang Club of Tidewater, and held in support of Trails of Purpose equine-assisted therapies and mental health counseling. The MCT happily welcomes all years, makes and models of passenger cars, trucks, and motorcycles to participate in this show.

This is a family friendly event, so feel free to bring the kids (or parents) so they can enjoy the show!!

Registration will be onsite only. There is no charge for spectators, who will be directed to parking adjacent to the show vehicle parking area.

Please only park in the designated areas for show and spectator parking, as directed by parking staff. There will be people who will post that they are taking online registrations.

They are scammers and not in any way authorized to do online registrations. DO NOT register with anyone online, as we will only do registration and accept payments (check/cash) at the show site.

This is a Judged Classes show, with multiple Class awards, and 4 top awards for Best in Show, Dealer’s Choice, VFW Choice, and Club Participation. There will also be a 50/50 drawing at the conclusion of the show.

Schedule: 9:00A | Registration Opens.

Clubs wishing to park together should arrive together to facilitate easier parking. Parking will be as directed by show staff. All entrant vehicles parked in the show vehicle area must pay the registration fee. Please do not arrive prior to 8:30 a.m. to allow for vendor and lot setup to occur.

10:00A | Driver's Meeting / Judging Begins. This is a Judged Classes show.

12:00P | Registration Closed. No further judged entries after this time.

1:00P | Judging Ends

1:30P | Car Show Awards Presented and 50/50 Drawing held. Good Luck!!

2:00P | Show Complete. Please exit safely and have a great day!!

The show schedule is subject to modification should the weather dictate we change it.

We are actively looking for Vendors to advertise and/or sell their products/services at this show. Vendor spaces are available for $25.00 + two (or more) cans/boxes of non-perishable food for donation. This allows you space for a 10x10 shelter and table setup, adjacent to the show vehicle parking area.

If you need additional space, please let us know. Email mustangcluboftidewater67@yahoo.com for more information. Trails of Purpose (https://www.trailsofpurpose.com) will also be attending, providing information on the services they offer to support service members and their families in their fight to overcome the negative effects of trauma, transition, and trials that result from their service in the military. Please visit them at the show!

Event Contact: Michael Marushia, President, MCT. 757-969-2038, MustangPilot55@gmail.com

past.title: Cars and Coffee Norfolk Goes to Chesapeake | Aug 1st
past.body:
(1st Sat) Cars and Coffee Norfolk Goes to Chesapeake

Saturday, August 1st | 9-11am

Located at Greenbrier Mall, 1401 Greenbrier Pkwy., Chesapeake.

Monthly car meet on the 1st  Saturday of every month. All cars, motorcycles, bicycles, etc. welcome! Free coffee and doughnuts!

***UPDATE - New Location*** 

We're temporarily hosting our first Saturday events at Greenbrier Mall in Chesapeake. We will be in the lot behind the old Sears, at the back of the mall. As you enter, turn left and drive around the perimeter of the parking lot to the back where we'll be set up with the tent.

Please be respectful of the temporary location and help us keep the event going. ABSOLUTELY NO: Revving, burnouts, loud music. Be on your best behavior and respect the location.

past.title: Nerds & Horsepower | July 25th
past.body:
Nerds & Horsepower

Saturday, July 25th | Noon-6P

Located at St. George Brewing Company- 204 Challenger Way, Hampton, Va

Where geek culture meets car culture! Join us at St. George Brewing Company for an exciting community event filled with awesome vehicles, unique vendors, collectibles, food, brews, and fandom fun.

Explore a marketplace featuring artists, makers, collectibles, anime-inspired goods, pop culture merchandise, and more while checking out an incredible variety of cars and automotive builds. Whether you’re into horsepower, gaming, anime, comics, or just looking for a fun day out, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

Car Showcase
Vendors & Artists
Nerd Culture & Collectibles
Food & Brews
Community & Fun

Cosplay Encouraged
